scope: Substantive and application-document pass for Goeree-Overflakkee, Goes, Goirle, Gooise Meren and Gorinchem.

verified: Current Omgevingsplan CVDR696521 remains the primary address-specific source.

Official building/environment permit page requires Omgevingsloket permit check/application and important information including building drawings/sketches of existing and future situation and participation information.
Regular decision period is 8 weeks with one possible 6-week extension.
Concept request is submitted through Omgevingsloket; more complete information improves feasibility review; municipality aims to respond within 8 weeks.

Current public concept-request page displays fee bands EUR 157.50 / 262.60 / 367.70 / 472.75 based on building costs and states 50% credit against a later final application. Because that page still links a 2025 leges regulation, these amounts are stored as current-page displayed amounts but flagged for 2026 tariff-currentness verification before product use.
Municipal Bibob form states Huisvestingswet permits can trigger Bibob and lists extensive supporting financial/ownership documents.
remaining: housing-specific current-plan rules for ordinary room rental and woningsplitsing
verify concept-request bands against current 2026 tariff table
activity-specific housing documents/studies beyond generic building package

verified: Current official electronic-channel decision explicitly lists 'Onttrekkingsvergunning-voor-kamerverhuur aanvragen', housing withdrawal for merging/business/demolition, 'Woning splitsen' and 'Splitsingsvergunning', all through Omgevingsloket.

Historical official permit publications confirm Goes has used planning-permit routes for kamerverhuur, including legalization where room rental conflicted with the plan; historical cases are evidence of route existence, not used as current substantive law.
records.quality: The current electronic-channel decision is a strong application-route source and prevents treating room rental/splitting as a generic building-only activity.
remaining: current substantive Huisvestingsverordening/Omgevingsplan criteria for room rental, withdrawal and splitting

verified: Municipality confirms current Omgevingsplan and that the council adopted the first plan amendment on 09-12-2025.

Official council material states Goirle has no Huisvestingsverordening permit system for kamergewijze verhuur and instead uses omgevingsvergunning for deviation from plan rules where room rental is not allowed.
The same official council response states a Beleidsregel niet-zelfstandige woonruimten (kamerverhuur) was adopted in 2015 to assess such deviation applications.

Multiple integrated legacy plan components define kamerverhuur and prohibit it within ordinary residential destinations; hospita letting to at most two persons without own facilities while owner occupies the dwelling is excluded from that definition in those plan rules.
remaining: verify whether 2015 room-rental policy is still current or has a successor
current woningsplitsing framework across relevant plan components
application document/drawing/study package and 2026 fees/decision period

verified: Municipal current product distinguishes building splitting for rental from cadastral splitting for sale.
Rental after splitting requires omgevingsvergunning; sale requires, in addition to the building-splitting route, a splitsingsvergunning for cadastral division.

Application sequence explicitly includes address-specific Omgevingsplan check, Bbl requirements such as fire safety, ventilation and daylight, concept application where plan deviation is needed, and relevant Omgevingsloket activities.

Cadastral splitting application requires owner/contact data, building address, cadastral extract <=6 months, cadastral map extract <=6 months, construction year, proof of compliant building split, detailed splitting plan and valuation report by a sworn real-estate agent.
Valuation report must describe maintenance condition, fire resistance of walls/ceilings/floors and possible routing of water/gas/electricity lines.
Additional documents can be requested.

Current municipal page displays splitsingsvergunning fee EUR 1,302 per dwelling/apartment/unit with maximum EUR 26,124.10; exact currentness against 2026 leges must be checked because a search hit also exposes the same figures in 2025 legislation.
remaining: current ordinary room-rental/omzetting framework and documents
2026 tariff-table verification for displayed splitting fee

verified: Current Huisvestingsverordening Gorinchem 2024 wijzigingsbesluit CVDR741741 is valid through 14-06-2028 and includes temporary opkoopbescherming.
The original CVDR720925 version is expired from 08-07-2025 and is not used as current law.
Current municipal 2026 policy overview lists the housing regulation among established housing policy.
Gorinchem Bibob policy explicitly identifies kamerverhuurbedrijven, omgevingsvergunningen for kamerverhuur/logies with five or more rooms and omzettingsvergunningen kamerverhuur as risk categories.
remaining: current substantive room-rental/omzetting and woningsplitsing framework beyond opkoopbescherming
official application route and required documents/drawings/studies
current 2026 activity-specific fees and decision periods
